title: Shared review — CookbookCore parser spec sign-off
description: Review all implementation beads, the test suite, documentation changes, and tester results against the spec acceptance criteria. Check that public API matches the cooklang-rs surface, quantity semantics are exact, error cases throw with valid line/column, xcodegen wiring is correct, and no out-of-scope features (unit conversion, scaling, extensions) have been introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Public API in CooklangParser.swift exactly matches the types declared in the spec (CooklangParser, Extensions, Converter, Recipe, Metadata, Section, Content, Step, Item, Ingredient, Cookware, Timer, Quantity, Value, CooklangError).
Quantity parsing semantics: every row in the spec table is correctly implemented.
Error cases: empty component name, empty value + non-empty unit, and double % each throw CooklangError.parse with non-empty message and valid (1-based) line and column.
No unit conversion logic, recipe scaling, or non-canonical extensions were added.
Converter and Extensions are stubs as required by the spec.
swift test and xcodebuild test both pass.
project.yml changes are minimal and correct: only packages: block and CookbookApp package dependency added.
import CookbookCore in CookbookApp/CookbookAppApp.swift is present and load-bearing.
